calls.text: 1 Journeyman Wireman calls for BVCC’s Holiday Services. The hours are 11pm-7:30am, Monday through Friday the scale is 33.08 an hour plus a $3.50 night shift differential. You will need scaffold safety, working at heights, and confined space certificates. You will also need to pass Disney’s background check.
